2019 Q2.gq: The slight delay in the development of COSE and Joaquin increases our guidance for project capital expenditure by about $5 million for a total of $45 million.

2020 Q3.gq: We are maintaining our forecast for gold production of 525,000 to 575,000 ounces in 2020.

2022 Q2.gq: We are maintaining our guidance for 2022 silver segment cash costs and all-in sustaining costs.

2022 Q4.bq: Silver production came in at the top end of the revised range we issued in November, while gold production was in line with our original operating outlook.

2023 Q2.bq: Consolidated Q2 silver production of 6 million ounces was at the high-end of our 2023 quarterly guidance and consolidated record gold production of 248,200 ounces also approach the upper end of the range.

2023 Q3.gq: Given year-to-date production and our outlook for the next two month, we are reaffirming our annual 2023 guidance ranges for silver and gold production with the expectation that production for both will come in at the low end of the ranges.

2025 Q4.bq: Turning to operating performance, attributable silver production of 22,800,000 ounces in 2025 exceeded the top end of the guidance range we increased in November, while attributable gold production of 742,200 ounces was within guidance.
